purpose: Fresh natural palette endpoints for continuous wildfire ambiance controls
notes: The CFG1 local path uses the positive prompt only. These are ten independent genuine generations; endpoint position describes the intended slider direction, not an acoustic measurement.

assets.title: Light air
assets.role: Lightweight airy low slider endpoint, without a heavy bass bed
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, A continuous seamless delicate outdoor air whisper, thin soft airy movement steadily drifting through fine grass, countless soft overlapping airy grains blending into one calm even sustained texture, transparent light wind with stable quiet volume and fine open-air detail throughout the whole recording. Length: 45 seconds.

assets.title: Fine scattering
assets.role: Clean delicate high-detail sifting ash, preserved without lo-fi filtering
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, A continuous even close high fidelity recording of fine dry papery ash softly sifting and gently rubbing together, many tiny overlapping flakes blending into one soft sustained detailed flutter, consistent quiet granular rustling at every moment, fine delicate clear full bandwidth texture and stable rounded dynamics throughout the whole recording. Length: 45 seconds.
